description: L2 planner, menu-only phase: read pool/l2 of a finished l4 module and write pool/l2/<device>/menu.json (device=web). Does not delete the pool, does not write pool/l1 or l2 web/. Parked steps stay on disk outside this flow.
principles: Sequence is declared in this file via dependsOn and done-anchors. Steps do not enqueue their successor by name.
Pipeline state lives on disk at l2/{module}/pipeline/pipeline.json. The task record is orchestration, not truth.
A step declared here and not implemented stops the run with pipeline.status awaitingStep naming that step. The task completes without failed.
Two entries, one path: a step created by L4 with prompt { moduleName, thread, file }, or @@agentPlannerL2 <lowerCamel> which reads every pool/l2 message. Both write the same pipeline.json.
Reads only the module l4 and pool/l2. Never reads l1. Writes l2/{module}/pipeline/ and l4/{module}/pool/l2/web/menu.json. Never deletes pool messages in this phase.
Deterministic first. entry10 has no LLM. menu20 spends one reasoning call on the UX cut.
listPoolBox may list menu.json; entry10 keeps only files named <stamp>_<thread>_<round>.

invocation.fromL4: step prompt JSON { moduleName, thread, file }
invocation.moduleRule: The module token is required and must be lowerCamel. The name is never inferred from prose.
invocation.l4Rule: The module l4 pipeline.json must be status complete. Otherwise the run is refused.
invocation.poolRule: No pool message in pool/l2 refuses with 'nothing pending for <mod> in pool/l2'. menu.json is not a message.
invocation.dedupeRule: Messages with the same moduleName, mode and artifacts are one request. Two different requests refuse: 'pool/l2 has N different requests; resolve with the l4 supervisor'.

steps.goal: Read every pool/l2 message (oldest first), group identical requests, refuse if they differ, wipe l2/{module}/pipeline and l2/{module}/web, write pipeline.json with sourceMessages. Never delete the pool.

One LLM call. Menu v2.2 tree (hub/page/group, organisms) from all journeys, access grants, ontology, workflows and the deterministic candidates (as data, not the answer), including records an actor maintains. Gate plus bounded repair. L2 stamps action vs the previous menu of the same device. Overwrite pool/l2/web/menu.json.
